title: How to write an ATS-optimized Resume with AI (according to research)
description:
How to write an ATS-optimized Resume with AI (according to research). 

Here are the best AI prompts you can use with ChatGPT or Google Gemini to write the perfect resume.

01:05 - Sciene behind the prompts
01:50 - How to find the best job description
03:11 - Resume AI prompts

"You are a professional resume writer and recruiter. use the job description following this sentence to create an ats-optimized resume template with prompts that I can fill in. Keep it to one page. include a summary, skills, work experience, and then education section:"

"You are a professional resume writer and recruiter. I have uploaded a copy of my current resume. update and tailor my summary and work experience sections to best match the job description so a recruiter will want to interview me. use results-driven accomplishments and bold all changes so I can review them. Here is the job description:"

Bonus AI prompts for resume writing:
"I have _ years of work experience, how long should my resume be?"
"What are the most common job titles for a ____ job?"
"I have a career gap of _ years, how do I account for that on my resume?"
"Based on the job description I provided, what are the most important skills that I need to have in the skills section so a recruiter will want to interview me?"
